title: Cost of Ad Variations for Meta Testing: 2026 Price Guide
summary: What 100 Meta ad variations cost in 2026, using published prices for hook swaps, batches and AI subscriptions, plus a worked count of concepts and variants.
body_markdown:
## A worked example: 100 variations from four concepts


Suppose you want 100 ads built from four concepts, with five hooks and five endings each. That is 100 variants (4 × 5 × 5). Three published routes price that differently:


- **Twirl:** if its $80 add-on applied to each of the 100 variants, that line alone would be $8,000 before the four base videos. The page lists $80 for variations without making clear whether that is per variation or per pack, so ask for a written quote.
- **CreatStrat:** $899 a month for 20 ads a week covers roughly 80 to 100 ads a month, or about $9 to $11 per ad. The ads are AI presenters, statics and mashups, and the page does not describe a revision policy.
- **Admiral Media:** its 80-ad batch works out to about 363 euros per ad, before the media and management it sells separately. The batch is built for game and app advertisers.


## Knowlify: finished AI video variations at about 25 a week


Knowlify is the best fit if you want 100 variations of a winning Meta ad delivered as finished video rather than as files to cut yourself. It makes about 25 finished ads a week, so four weeks produce about 100 ads by our arithmetic. The first batch lands on day five, a person checks every ad before delivery, and the three formats (AI UGC, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials) let you test a new look as well as a new hook. Tell Knowlify how many of the 100 should be new concepts and how many are hook or ending changes, and ask for a quote for that mix and whether approved variants count toward the weekly volume.


Pricing is a custom quote, and you can take creative only or have Knowlify run the Meta campaigns. Where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. On creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund (terms on[the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ).


**When to pick another option:** if you need real creators on camera, look at Brighter Click or Insense. If you want a low-priced subscription of recurring weekly volume, CreatStrat and Adguns publish their prices. For what a full video ad costs by production model, see our[video ad production cost guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/video-ad-production-cost) .


## Key takeaways


- Price the count in concepts first. 100 variants can be four concepts with 25 variants each, or 100 unrelated ads.
- Variation prices are rare. Twirl's $80 listed for extra hooks or calls to action is the clearest published one.
- Published prices run from about $9 to $11 per ad on an AI subscription to about 500 euros per ad in a 20-ad batch (our arithmetic).
- Knowlify's about 25 finished ads a week is roughly 100 a month, with a custom quote and a 90-day refund guarantee (terms on the site). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. Ask how variants count.


## FAQ


### How many ad variations should I test on Meta each week?


The right number depends on your concepts and budget. Meta's guidance recommends ads that are truly different in look, feel, storyline and message rather than minor edits of one ad, so count concepts first. Our[creative testing framework](https://knowlify.com/articles/ad-creative-testing) shows how to set up the test.


### Is it cheaper to make variations than new ads?


Usually, yes, when the variation reuses footage you already own, such as a new hook, caption or call to action. Twirl lists $80 for extra hooks or calls to action on the same footage, against a self-serve video from $325. A new presenter or script is a new ad.


### Does Meta charge for Advantage+ creative variations?


[Meta's Advantage+ creative page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/meta-advantage-plus/creative) , as we checked in October 2026, lists no separate price for the variations it generates. You still pay for the media you run. Some enhancements can be on by default, so preview them before launch and turn off any you do not want.


### Do cut-downs count as new ads?


Count them as variants of one concept, not as new concepts. Meta's guidance treats ads with identical visuals and different text as iteration. Cut-downs are usually the cheapest variations, but a plan that counts them as new ideas overstates the number of concepts you are testing.
